audit.corrected: whys[3] rewritten to the 4-5 window (rank-two E plus passive spirit sustain against Blaze ramp), whys[4] moved to Between Worlds at 6, whys[5] moved to the first-item rotation. Sides and ratings are unchanged, so this is a why-only realignment and no chart row moves.

audit.why: The decisive interaction is stated correctly and repeatedly: Sear (Q) only stuns a target already carrying Blaze, so Brand must land Pillar of Flame (W) or Conflagration (E) first. Blaze at three stacks detonates after 2 seconds and applies spell effects. Pyroclasm bounces off nearby bodies, so spreading blunts it. Conflagration is 625 range and its spread doubles on ablaze targets. Aurora's answers — W's leap/invisibility, E's slow plus backhop, and Between Worlds' slow zone against a dashless champion — are all correctly attributed.
breakdown.cooldowns carries real numbers straight from the kit: Sear 8s at rank 1 / 6s maxed, Conflagration 13s at rank 1, Pillar of Flame 10s, Pyroclasm 100s. No hedging, no unsourced magnitude.
